observer.service_effect_normalization: Organizational service classes are keyed by endpoint action type and exact graph effect only. Counter/resource magnitudes are retained as diagnostics but are excluded from organizational service-class identity and all depth-erased promotion gates.

plateau.nonclaim: bounded scanner plateau only; not eternal closure and not an algebraic raised carrier
plateau.required: four consecutive completed post-calibration levels with byte-identical normalized full scanner signatures after the last structural-shock family, while exact construction depth and at least one interior-complexity diagnostic strictly increase

representation_transition.nonclaim: observer-relative matched finite-horizon candidate only; not a carrier/type fixed point and not yet an algebraic raised O-group
representation_transition.required: the frozen matched longitudinal depth-erased action/service packet is byte-identical across four consecutive synthetic levels, exact matched constructions differ, matched interior complexity strictly grows, and the broad exploratory guard remains in the same grammar/resource/service regime

structural_shock.audit_note: This replaces the v1.1 rule that allowed exploratory farthest-point beam membership changes to trigger a raise candidate.
structural_shock.required: at least three normalized matched-longitudinal lane signatures change together at one synthetic depth and the exact post-change matched lane signatures persist one further level

purpose: Scan theorem-certified O-depth as an evolving organizational regime with two complementary lanes: a broad exploratory Scout beam and a frozen matched longitudinal backbone. The kernel is scale-independent so an earned regime/group can later become the subject of the same scanner through a new adapter.

scanner_kernel.future_adapter_rule: If a raised group object is later earned, implement only a new adapter. Keep lane definitions, genealogy, promotion gates and checkpoint semantics unchanged unless an explicit scanner theorem/reopen event requires revision.
scanner_kernel.subject_contract: An adapter supplies an ordered sequence of comparable exact/bounded objects, a canonical construction identity, frozen actions/observer data, and a pre-outcome selection vector. The kernel itself does not depend on O-level numbering.

scientific_question: As O depth increases under the already-earned ownership-preserving recursive lift, does the full organizational signature merely repeat, mature toward a plateau, undergo a structural shock, or support a new observer-relative service/representation that justifies a higher group-level investigation?
source_exclusions: old cosmology/field theory is not a premise
quarantined descriptor-only Phase9 organizational-function side experiment is not authority

stopping.confirmation_rule: Automatic structural-shock raises require matched-longitudinal lane changes in >=3 independent normalized families plus one exact post-change holdout level. Exploratory beam histogram/median changes are diagnostic only. Matched representation windows remain self-confirming at W=4; promotion to an earned raised group still requires adversarial validation.
